label: Figure 24.2: Exporting when the world price is above the domestic price
alt: Same S(Domestic)/D diagram as Figure 24.1 but with the horizontal S(World) line drawn above the autarky price Pe, so domestic demand falls to Q1, domestic supply rises to Q2, and the surplus Q1Q2 is exported.
caption: With the same domestic S(Domestic) and D as Figure 24.1, but a world price P<sub>w</sub> = $28/kg above the autarky price P<sub>e</sub> = $22, domestic quantity demanded falls to Q<sub>1</sub> = 120,000 tonnes while domestic output expands to Q<sub>2</sub> = 240,000 tonnes; the surplus of 120,000 tonnes is exported at the higher world price.
